lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters arranged in approximately four horizontal rows posterior to the fifth gill slit, with spatial frequency decreasing towards the posterior boundary of the frame.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the primary high-luminance blobs to create a coordinate-like grid on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient transitioning from high-intensity reflection on the dorsal edge to low-intensity shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density concentration of small-diameter, high-luminance spots across the visible surface of the pectoral fin, with a notable increase in density along the leading edge.
